instruction: Candid medium shot in a bright office. The man in the white shirt (R5) and the man in the denim shirt (R2) stand on the left, facing right. The man in the black t-shirt and beanie (R1) stands in the center, smiling broadly. The woman in the plaid blazer (R3) stands on the right, facing left. They all stack their hands in a central huddle. Bright, even indoor lighting.
elements: R1 is the central participant in the hand-stack huddle while R2, R3, and R5 face inward toward the shared contact
R2 and R5 face toward R1 and the central hand stack rather than R1 facing toward them from the side
R3 faces inward toward the central hand stack with R1 rather than standing as a non-participating onlooker
R1, R2, R3, and R5 all place their hands into one shared central huddle
The interaction takes place in a bright office
